headline: Standardizing and harmonizing heterogeneous biomedical datasets for predictive modeling
label: Harmonized Biomedical Data For Ml
summary: Recent preprints and a preregistered pipeline address standardization, batch effects, missingness and lock-box validation for ML prediction on biomedical data.
synthesis: The common thread is data readiness for machine learning on biomedical measurements: standardization, harmonization, imputation and held-out evaluation. MetaboNet consolidates multiple public type 1 diabetes CGM and insulin-pump datasets into one standardized resource of 3135 subjects and 1228 patient-years. Fed-ComBat applies federated batch-effect harmonization to neuroimaging across decentralized cohorts while preserving nonlinear covariate effects. CROT addresses patch-based missing values in single-cell data using cluster-regularized optimal transport, reporting higher accuracy. The preregistered infant video pipeline, built on off-the-shelf pose estimation, generic features and AutoML, reports ROC-AUC 0.77 on a lock-box set. What is new is the emphasis on preregistration, federated harmonization and lock-box evaluation. The pattern is dominant rather than universal, since MetaboNet and CROT concentrate on data resources and imputation methods rather than predictive validation.
